Garage Beer expects to reach 300,000 barrels, but competing with established giants such as Michelob Ultra remains a significant challenge as it seeks long-term growth.
title: Kelces’ Garage Beer sales surge 252% as major rival looms

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Pradeep Mundeja conquered the Everest Base Camp trek, soaring to a height of 5,364 meters. His journey spanned about 130 km, navigating extreme cold and altitude challenges. As a hearing-impaired individual, Mundeja independently orchestrated this expedition, receiving vital support from a trekking group. His employer, Punjab National Bank, hailed his monumental achievement on social media, showcasing the significance of determination and community backing.
title: Hearing-impaired Karnal bank manager treks 130 km to Everest Base Camp

author: PRABIN KALITA
description: Bosiram Siram has raised concerns about Chinese troops entering Indian territory in Upper Subansiri district. He led a Congress delegation that visited border areas to gather information. During their trip, which took place from August 26 to August 29, they spoke with local residents. Chief Minister Pema Khandu, however, has denied these claims of incursion. The situation reflects ongoing tensions along the India-China border.
title: China 40-50km inside Arunachal, says state Congress chief Bosiram Siram

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Instagram is rolling out new testing features to support long-form content creators, introducing 90-minute horizontal videos. Creators can enhance engagement by linking short clips to their full-length productions. The platform is also experimenting with a 'Series' feature for episodic Reels on profiles. Live videos might be incorporated into the Reels tab, broadening content recommendations as Instagram plans to expand these features globally shortly.
title: Instagram tests 90-minute horizontal videos for long-form content creators

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a legal battle, California resident Wei Shi has taken the City of Palos Verdes Estates to court, claiming excessive delays in the approval of his accessory dwelling unit application. Shi asserts that the city violated state law’s requirements for prompt reviews. Thanks to a favorable ruling from an appeals court, his lawsuit is back on track, seeking over $1 million in damages for these holdups.
title: Court revives homeowner's lawsuit over delayed second dwelling approval

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: In a dramatic turn of events during the Women's Under-19 cricket clash, Jharkhand encountered a major setback due to a scoring mishap against Uttarakhand. Allegations have surfaced from the Jharkhand Cricket Association suggesting that a run was erroneously left off, altering their results from a draw to a narrow loss.
title: One-run defeat sparks controversy! BCCI receives complaint over scorer's blunder

author: AASTHA JHA
description: Beatrice Keul has come forward with serious allegations, stating that Donald Trump raped her during a press luncheon at the Plaza Hotel in 1993. She reports being promised support for a US visa and educational opportunities, resulting in her feeling lost and afraid. Not long after, she says Jeffrey Epstein reached out to her with similar offers and invitations to exclusive events.
title: 'Epstein organized many parties with Don': Ex-Miss Swiss accuses Trump of 'brutal' rape

author: YUDHVIR RANA
description: Teerath Singh was shot dead outside a gurdwara in Cheete Kalan village while his friend sustained injuries. Both men were returning from paying respects at the gurdwara when the suspected assailants opened fire. Preliminary investigations indicate the murder was connected to an old land dispute rather than political rivalry. Police have identified four suspects and filed an FIR, but no arrests have been made yet.
title: Son of AAP sarpanch shot dead outside gurdwara in Amritsar

author: ALOKKNMISHRA
description: On Sunday, special camps were held across nearly 15,000 polling stations in Delhi for electoral roll revision. Only around 3,000 people submitted Form-6 applications for name inclusion during this period. Additionally, around 1,000 applications were submitted for deletions and corrections through Forms 7 and 8. Since August 31, approximately 47.6 lakh voters were deleted from the draft electoral rolls. A total of only 2.
title: Just 3k turn up at last special SIR camp for inclusion of names in Delhi voter rolls

author: RAM SUNDARAM
description: Seventeen undertrial inmates managed to escape from Thekkampatti sub-jail in Tamil Nadu's Theni district. They faked epileptic seizures to lure prison personnel into opening their cell. Once the guards entered, the inmates attacked them and fled the facility. Four of the escapees have been apprehended while thirteen remain at large despite extensive police efforts. Investigations into the jailbreak and security lapses at the jail are currently ongoing.
title: Fake seizures, attack on prison guards: How 17 inmates escaped TN jail at midnight

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: New research highlights that individuals frequently misjudge how much others enjoy their company during interactions. This phenomenon, known as the liking gap, shows that people are harsher judges of their own performance. Participants in studies indicated they liked their partners more than expected. Observers are often unaware of each other's internal doubts and nervousness during conversations. Understanding this may encourage more positive interactions as connections develop over time.
title: People may like you more than you think after first meeting

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Anders Fernstedt, a homeless man, has lived outside a £210 million mansion in London’s Knightsbridge for three and a half years. While the 45-room property remains empty, he survives on donated food and clothes, uses power banks to read books on his phone and relies on charity services for essentials. Neighbours have gradually accepted his presence.
title: Homeless man lives outside £210M London mansion for 3.5 years

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: As he prepares for the Test series versus New Zealand, Devdutt Padikkal reflects on his journey in cricket. He stresses the need for adaptability in adverse weather conditions and the value of video analysis in refining his technique. Discussions with seasoned players have played a crucial role in his development. Despite facing health challenges, he is focused on capitalizing on the opportunities that lie ahead.
title: ‘I thought my career was over’: Padikkal on toughest phase ahead of NZ Tests

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: Afghan nationals deported from Pakistan have alleged arbitrary arrests, midnight raids and extortion in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa following the imposition of governor’s rule and a state of emergency by the Shehbaz Sharif government. Returnees said police were demanding bribes for release. Nearly 27,000 Afghan refugees have returned through Torkham in three months, amid resettlement efforts.
title: Afghan returnees face raids, arbitrary arrests in Pakistan's KP after emergency

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: A US appeals court denied the Trump administration's request to prevent California from counting mail ballots from alleged 'non-citizens'. This ruling is part of the administration's ongoing efforts regarding voter eligibility and non-citizen voting. The Justice Department claimed some individuals on the voter list were charged with illegal voting. Voting rights activists expressed concern over potential misidentification of naturalised citizens as non-citizens.
title: Trump's bid to block California mail ballots over 'non-citizens' hits court roadblock

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: New Zealand's critically endangered southern dotterel population has risen by 52 percent following focused predator control efforts. Intensive campaigns targeting feral cats on Stewart Island have yielded immediate gains in breeding. The population grew from 105 birds in early 2025 to an estimated 160 in April 2026. Wildlife officials stress that ongoing management of feral cats is crucial for the bird's long-term survival.
title: Feral cat control helps NZ dotterel population rise from 105 to 160

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Skydance has implemented a strict policy requiring all employees to return to the office five days per week, reflecting a significant shift in workplace expectations. Alongside this, they are introducing a Voluntary Buyout Program aimed at optimizing their workforce. This strategic direction is in response to the recent merger with Paramount-Skydance, promoting a unified corporate culture.
title: Skydance offers voluntary buyouts, orders 5-day office work after Warner Bros merger

author: RAM SUNDARAM
description: In a dramatic escape from Thekkampatti sub-jail in Theni district, 17 inmates faked seizures to attack guards. Police have since arrested four escapees, including Praveen Kumar and three others from Theni and Madurai. A statewide manhunt is ongoing for the remaining thirteen inmates still at large. Authorities have released photos and details to assist in locating the fugitives.
title: 17 inmates escape Theni sub-jail in Tamil Nadu; 4 caught, 13 missing

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
description: Brazilian Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has been ordered to surrender his passports and is prohibited from leaving the country following his electoral defeat to President Lula. This decision, stemming from a money-laundering investigation, also restricts his communication with an implicated lawyer as political tensions rise in Brazil after the election results.
title: Brazil court orders defeated Bolsonaro to surrender passports, bars him from leaving

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current made history by welcoming a record crowd for their final home match of the 2026 season. Around 18,000 fans were expected, including 6,000 at Current Landing, where a $10 Ground Pass offered outdoor viewing, food and entertainment. The club also celebrated two new dining options and plans to host more events, expanding its reach beyond CPKC Stadium and strengthening its connection with Kansas City.
title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current set record with 18,000 fans

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Whitney Anderson, 45, bought a 128-year-old abandoned church in Michigan for $45,000 and is turning it into her dream home. She has spent an estimated $194,000 on renovations since June 2024 and hopes to complete most of the work by 2028. As costs could reach $400,000, Anderson describes the project as the biggest gamble of her life.
title: Michigan woman buys 128-year-old church for $45K, turns it into home

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A walnut farmer in California revolutionized his sales with a targeted email marketing campaign. Reaching out to prior cherry customers, he uncovered 300 interested buyers for his walnuts. This approach resulted in his gross revenue tripling against wholesale prices, proving that even a small customer base can boost income stability. Consequently, many farmers are now embracing direct sales strategies to lessen financial uncertainties.
title: California farmer's email experiment triples walnut crop's gross revenue

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: US President Donald Trump’s approval rating has increased to 32 percent, showing a small recovery. In contrast, a recent poll indicates that registered voters prefer Democrats over Republicans by 47 percent to 36 percent. As the midterm elections approach, voter enthusiasm appears to be higher among Democrats compared to Republicans. Additionally, voters’ views on economic management have shifted, favoring Democrats slightly over Republicans.
title: Trump’s approval ratings slightly recover after record low last week: Report

description: Jessica Alba, Paris Hilton and Jenna Dewan are backing the 2026 Baby of the Year contest, which has generated more than $45 million in grants for Baby2Baby since 2024. The fundraiser supports children across the US with essentials including diapers, formula, food and clothing. The winner will receive $25,000 and a national advertising campaign opportunity.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The ecosystem of Nu'utele Island is flourishing thanks to successful conservation strategies that eliminated invasive species. This revitalization has enabled native flora to rebound, supporting local farmers in sustainable crop cultivation. The eradication of predatory species has also facilitated the revival of native birds, while sea turtles have finally returned to lay their eggs on the island’s shores after years of absence.
title: Sea turtles return to Samoa island after decades as rats and pigs are removed

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a strategic move to enhance marine ecosystems, the retired fishing vessel F/V Calcasieu Pass has been sunk off the Delaware coast to function as an artificial reef. This initiative, aimed at supporting diverse aquatic species, involved meticulously clearing hazardous materials before the sinking. Environmental authorities will oversee the area, monitoring the growth and health of the marine habitats it spawns in the years to come.
title: Delaware sank 180-foot ship bought for $1 to create artificial reef

description: Mumbai Indians missed the Women’s Premier League playoffs last season after injuries and illness disrupted their combinations and close games slipped away. New head coach Luke Williams believes the franchise can return to contention without making wholesale changes. With Harmanpreet Kaur continuing as captain, Williams wants to retain the core, fine-tune player roles and target the right additions at the October 28 auction as Mumbai look to bounce back.
title: 'Not trying to reinvent the wheel': Luke Williams backs MI's core for WPL 2027

description: Pittsburgh Penguins captain Sidney Crosby is known for his accomplishments on the ice, but his private life is largely off the public radar. Long-term partner Kathy Leutner has also maintained a low profile while pursuing a modelling career. The couple, who have reportedly been together since 2008, have seemingly preferred privacy, mutual support and keeping romance away from the intense attention hockey brings.

The Bayern Munich striker also claimed the Gerd Müller Trophy, completing a historic double after scoring 73 goals for club and country. His extraordinary campaign marks a defining moment in his career and English football history.

description: On Monday, three individuals lost their lives in separate incidents on Central Railway tracks. The accidents happened amid significant service disruptions following a fire in a signalling hut. Passengers experienced delays of 70 to 90 minutes, affecting both local and long-distance train operations. Many commuters turned to alternative modes of transport like autorickshaws and buses while trying to reach their destinations.
title: 3 killed on Mumbai locals tracks, 80 services cancelled, delays up to 90 minutes

author: KANGKAN KALITA
description: Adi organisations, including Adi Bane Kebang-United, have expressed strong opposition to the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. Local families claim that 80% of affected households are against the proposed dam. While some individuals have agreed to a pre-feasibility study, the majority remains opposed. The organisations accuse the government of violating tribal rights and encroaching on ancestral lands. They are demanding a public debate to discuss the project and its implications.
title: Anti-dam protests: Are we from Pak, China that govt is silencing us?
